nom: d'Alba Piedmont Double Serum All In One Multi Balm Stick

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin repeatedly describe it as a go-to for dry patches, cracked skin, and winter dryness, with noticeably softer skin within one to two weeks.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers with mature skin report a slight plumping effect and smoother-looking skin around fine lines.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found it too sticky for her skin type, while another with oily skin used it only as a targeted spot treatment on dry patches to avoid shine on the rest of her face.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin found it worked well, though she suspected it could be too rich for oilier skin types.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers say it makes fine lines, crow's feet, and smile lines look softer and plumper over time, but one reports her undereye area looked more wrinkled and saggy after one to two weeks of daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers mostly describe it as hydrating for dry patches, especially under the eyes, though one says it dried out her skin and caused flaking.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report their dark spots getting lighter and their complexion brighter with continued use.

aspects.libelle: Feels sticky or tacky on application
Doesn't fully absorb, can feel heavy

extraits.texte: It just me or does everyone have the same problem. I have bought this product twice. Same problem. I threw away the first one because I thought i got a bad one. Purchased again and it does the same thing every time I apply it it breaks in to hard crumbs.

I fell for the hype & bought this. Used it every morning. It feels great, it instantly melts into a serum and felt very moisturizing. After 1-2 weeks though, I noticed my undereye area looked wrinkly and saggy. I decided not to use this balm stick for a few days. My undereye area improved & now looks like it did before I started using this balm stick. This product didn't do anything for the rest of my face. The balm stick is almost empty anyways, but I definitely will not repurchase. If you're noticing your skin is looking worse, it may be this product.

extraits.titre: May or not be suited for people with oily skin
extraits.texte: I think this is a good product for those who do not have oily skin. It does feel nice on one's skin but it was a little sticky for me. I also have oily skin so probably not the best pairing.

Smells nice and feels light on my skin. I like the push application method. I used it multiple ways - under moisturizer and on top of it. I didn't notice any significant effects but I did see it dried out my skin a touch - it started to flake. Perhaps this is a good thing and new skin is resurfacing. I will continue to use this but I cannot say I would recommend to a friend based on my experience so far.

extraits.titre: A New Favorite for Dry Skin
extraits.texte: I had never tried a skincare product in a stick form like this before, and I have to say, I love it. It's incredibly easy to use and so practical, especially for quick touch-ups throughout the day. I was given this product as a free sample to review, and I ended up finishing the entire stick, which I almost never do with samples. At first, I was worried it might feel greasy, but it actually absorbs really nicely into the skin. I started using it when I was dealing with very dry, cracked skin on my forehead from cold, dry weather. It had gotten so bad that my dryness was showing through my makeup and making it difficult to apply smoothly. Once I started using this multi-balm, the dryness became much less noticeable almost immediately. After about a week of consistent use, my skin felt healed and smooth again. I have mature skin, and I also noticed a slight plumpness in my face, which was a really nice bonus. It has a subtle citrusy scent that feels fresh but not overpowering. I definitely recommend this balm, especially if you struggle with dry patches or want something convenient and effective. After two weeks, I started pairing it with the d'Alba Refresh Aqua Serum, and I loved the results even more.

I liked that I could place the product directly where its needed. I have oily skin with small dry patches along my eyebrow. I was able to use directly on the dry spots without making my whole face too shiny. Fragrance it light and did not bother me. I used product along eye brows, under eyes, and on my lips.
